# cpanel_ssl_csrs (Data Source)

Reads the complete stored SSL certificate signing request metadata inventory without exposing CSR PEM, modulus values, or ECDSA public parameters.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "cpanel_ssl_csrs" "all" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `csrs` (Attributes List) The stored CSRs sorted by cPanel identifier. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--csrs))

<a id="nestedatt--csrs"></a>
### Nested Schema for `csrs`

Read-Only:

- `common_name` (String) The CSR common name, when reported.
- `created` (Number) The creation time as a Unix timestamp.
- `domains` (List of String) The CSR domains in sorted order.
- `ecdsa_curve_name` (String) The ECDSA curve name, or `null` when not applicable.
- `friendly_name` (String) The CSR display name.
- `id` (String) The CSR identifier assigned by cPanel.
- `key_algorithm` (String) The public-key algorithm, when reported.
- `modulus_length` (Number) The RSA modulus length, or `null` when not applicable.
